Variables: p, q, r, s
Each variable denotes its own fixed Boolean input; meanings cannot be renamed.
Admissible C: (((s IMPLIES q) IMPLIES (r AND p)) IMPLIES ((p AND q) AND (r IMPLIES s)))
Required Q: ((((s IMPLIES q) IMPLIES (r AND p)) IMPLIES ((p AND q) AND (r IMPLIES s))) AND s)
Question: does Q hold for EVERY assignment satisfying C?
Return UNSAFE with a concrete C=true, Q=false assignment if not.
An empty admissible domain makes the universal claim vacuously SAFE.

Variables: p, q, r, s
Each variable denotes its own fixed Boolean input; meanings cannot be renamed.
Admissible C: ((((r AND TRUE) IMPLIES (NOT q)) AND (p AND (s IMPLIES s))) OR ((NOT (p IMPLIES s)) AND ((q IMPLIES r) OR (q AND q))))
Required Q: ((((r AND TRUE) IMPLIES (NOT q)) AND (p AND (s IMPLIES s))) AND ((NOT (p IMPLIES s)) AND ((q IMPLIES r) OR (q AND q))))
Question: does Q hold for EVERY assignment satisfying C?
Return UNSAFE with a concrete C=true, Q=false assignment if not.
An empty admissible domain makes the universal claim vacuously SAFE.
